keyword: why did trump fire pam bondi
claims: President Trump fired Attorney General Pam Bondi on April 2, 2026.
Pam Bondi was in office for 14 months.
Trump said in a deleted social media post that Pam Bondi was "all talk, no action" regarding investigations into his political opponents.
Pam Bondi was replaced by Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche.
Todd Blanche is a former personal lawyer for Trump.
Pam Bondi was the second cabinet member to lose their job in recent weeks, according to The New York Times.
